name: precondition-not-visible-only-with-file-setup-valid
description: precondition with only `notVisible` set is valid, using a flow-fragment file path as setup.
yaml:
appId: com.example.app
name: Smoke with precondition
env: {}

    setup: flows/dismiss-onboarding.yml
